T: A friendly ghost who cooks. Keep him.
D: A friendly ghost befriends the daughter of a ghost therapist who moves into his haunted manor.
P: Serve the breakfast feast when Casper cooks for Kat.
S: Lobster salad with mayo, celery and chives in a buttered toasted bun
Cooked lobster or prawn meat chopped and folded with a little mayo, lemon, celery and chives, piled into butter-toasted split rolls.
white chocolate and sea salt, pretzels, lollies and little marshmallows, can I keep you

Fresh popcorn drizzled with white chocolate and sea salt, tossed with pretzels and candy corn, with little marshmallow ghosts hiding in the bowl. Pop 100g kernels in 2 tbsp oil in a covered pot and tip onto a lined tray. Toss with 100g pretzels and 80g candy corn. Melt 150g white chocolate and drizzle over, then sprinkle with flaky salt. Draw tiny eyes on 12 large marshmallows with a food-safe black marker and scatter through. Set 20 minutes, then break into chunks.
M: Casper serves Kat and her dad a breakfast to win them over

Fluffy buttermilk pancakes, crisp bacon, soft scrambled eggs, golden hash browns and berries, all piled onto one huge plate with maple syrup. Whisk 250g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 375ml buttermilk, 2 eggs and 40g melted butter and rest 15 minutes. Bake 8 hash browns at 220C for 20 minutes. Fry 8 rashers bacon. Cook pancakes in butter 2 minutes a side. Whisk 6 eggs with a splash of cream and cook slowly in butter until just set. Pile onto 4 plates with 250g berries and maple syrup.

New England clam chowder: bacon rendered, onion, celery and potato softened, clam liquor and milk, clams and cream at the end, served in bread bowls.
W: Lattice topped blueberry pie, served with vanilla ice cream
Blueberries tossed with sugar, lemon zest and cornflour, in a double crust with a lattice top, baked at 190C for 50 minutes, cooled 3 hours to set. Vanilla ice cream.
Crisp piped meringue ghosts with chocolate chip eyes
Egg whites whisked with caster sugar to stiff, glossy peaks, piped into tall teardrop ghosts, two mini choc chip eyes pressed in, baked at 100C for 90 minutes and left to cool in the oven.
K: Vanilla ice cream with cream soda poured over, served with long spoons
Cold cream soda poured over vanilla ice cream so it fizzes up white and ghostly.

dishes.n: Fatso's clam chowder in bread bowls
dishes.make_ahead: Make the chowder up to the potato stage 2 days ahead and keep it chilled; add the cream and clams and toast the loaves on the night

steps.text: Soak and scrub the clams. Dice the bacon, onion, celery and potatoes.
Steam the clams open in a covered pot and strain the liquid.
Render the bacon, add the onion and celery and cook until soft.
Add the potatoes, clam liquid and milk and simmer.
Stir in the cream and clams. Hollow out and toast the cob loaves and ladle the chowder in.

Add the potatoes, stock, nori and milk and simmer.
Stir in the cream and corn. Hollow out and toast the cob loaves and ladle the chowder in.
Toss the blueberries with the sugar, lemon zest and cornflour.

Cool before slicing.

s.note: Lobster salad with mayo, celery and chives in a buttered toasted bun
s.how: Chop 300g cooked lobster or prawn meat and fold with 3 tbsp mayo, lemon juice, a finely diced celery stick and chives. Butter and toast 4 split hot dog buns and pile the filling in.

m.n: Fatso's clam chowder in bread bowls
m.note: Creamy bacon and potato clam chowder in hollowed toasted cob loaves
m.how: Steam 1kg clams open and strain the liquid. Render 150g bacon, add an onion, 2 celery sticks and 500g diced potato. Add the clam liquid and 500ml milk and simmer 15 minutes. Stir in 150ml cream and the clams. Ladle into 4 hollowed, toasted cob loaves.

w.note: Lattice topped blueberry pie, served with vanilla ice cream
w.how: Toss 750g blueberries with 150g sugar, lemon zest and 3 tbsp cornflour. Line a pie dish with 2 sheets sweet shortcrust, fill and weave a lattice from 2 more. Bake at 190C for 50 minutes and cool 3 hours. Serve with vanilla ice cream.

w.note: Crisp piped meringue ghosts with chocolate chip eyes
w.how: Whisk 3 egg whites with a pinch of cream of tartar, then add 180g caster sugar a spoon at a time until stiff and glossy. Pipe tall teardrop ghosts and press in 2 mini choc chips each for eyes. Bake at 100C for 90 minutes and cool in the oven.

d.note: Vanilla ice cream with cream soda poured over, served with long spoons
d.how: Put 2 scoops vanilla ice cream into each of 4 tall glasses. Pour 1.25L cold cream soda over slowly so it foams up the sides, and serve with long spoons and straws.
